original_content_full:
The following papers got accepted at the 15th International Conference on Information Visualization Theory and Applications (IVAPP '24).

  • Daniel Atzberger, Tim Chech, Willy Scheibel, Jürgen Döllner, and Tobias Schreck: "Quantifying Topic Model Influence on Text Layouts based on Dimensionality Reductions"
  • Christoph Thiede, Willy Scheibel, and Jürgen Döllner: "Bringing Objects to Life: Supporting Program Comprehension through Animated 2.5D Object Maps from Program Traces"

The IVAPP conference is part of VISIGRAPP, the 19th International Joint Conference on Computer Vision, Imaging and Computer Graphics Theory and Applications.
It will be held in Rome, Italy from February 27 to 29. Visit their website for details.
